name: MATH 3650
title: Financial Mathematics II
description: The continuation of MATH 2620. Measurement of financial risk, the mathematics of capital budgeting, mathematical analysis of financial decisions and capital structure, and option pricing theory.
requirement_description: MATH 2620; ACCT 2001, which may be taken concurrently. Cannot be taken for credit after passing MATH 5621. Repeat restrictions apply- see www.advising.uconn.edu/repeat-policy.
